p08-r1-A12-dsv4-tc:
It builds on the white-bear steering idea (Raman et al., 2026, in `papers/`): a stance carried by a direction,
applied at a large dose in the mid-depth concept-allocation zone (layers 20-24; cf. Henry 2026). It is a different
method rather than a reproduction: WBS contrasts voluntary activation against *active suppression* ("think about X"
vs "do not think about X") over `directed_modulation`'s 35 pair items; this vector contrasts activation against a
*neutral, no-concept baseline* over `multi_concept_directed_modulation`. The two directions agree at cosine ≈ 0.78
at layers 20-24, so they are related but not the same axis.

, matching
WBS's report that large, specific doses are required.
